_note: piece = имя файла, piece_desc = кусок промпта. Подставляется в workflows/05. Стиль и фон дописывает сам workflow.

playable.pawn: gaunt undead chess pawn soldier, cracked bone armour, hollow eye sockets, tattered crimson tabard, chipped shortsword
playable.knight: undead chess knight, skeletal horse skull fused to the shoulder, jagged mane of sinew, lance of femurs
playable.bishop: undead chess bishop, tall mitre of split skull, blindfold of dried leather, censer swinging on a chain
playable.rook: undead chess rook, walking tower of stacked vertebrae and rusted iron plates, arrow slits glowing crimson
playable.queen: undead chess queen, crown of fused ribs, long torn veil, six clawed arms, cold teal glow inside the chest
playable.archbishop: chimeric chess piece merging bishop mitre and horse skull, asymmetric, dripping wax and marrow
playable.chancellor: chimeric chess piece merging rook tower and horse skull, siege-engine limbs, chains and pistons
playable.fiend: abomination chess piece, every piece type grafted into one mass, crown and tower and skull and blades, crimson veins
playable.king: crowned undead chess king, heavy mantle of hide, one leg fused into stone, slow and immense
playable.infiltrator: lean cloaked chess piece, bone dagger, low crouch, half-dissolved into shadow, thin teal rim light
playable.bastion: squat fortified chess piece, tower shield of fused shields, hunched, iron braced, immovable

enemies.guard: armoured skeletal chess guard with a bone halberd, standing at attention
enemies.necromancer: hooded skeletal chess figure, floating bone shards orbiting the head, sickly teal light
enemies.double: mirror-image chess piece, glassy pale surface, faint duplicate outline offset behind it
enemies.assassin: thin chess piece wrapped in black rags, two curved bone blades, no face
enemies.priest: chess piece in mouldering vestments, holding a censer of burning marrow, kneeling posture
enemies.frost_mage: chess piece encased in pale teal ice, frost spikes bursting from the shoulders

bosses.bishop_torturer: colossal chess bishop stitched from three corpses, three faces on the mitre, inquisitor chains, dripping
bosses.linked_rooks: two chess rooks fused back to back by rusted chains, both facing outward, cracked stone bases
bosses.puppeteer: chess knight marionette hung from taut sinew strings, limbs slack, iron cross bar above
bosses.red_king: enormous demonic red chess king on a throne of his own bones, legs fused into the floor, crimson glow
